about_the_game:
In the Pengpong demo, you can only play the following content.

  • Three difficulty levels in Stage 1

  • Five starting weapons

  • Unlock some meta programming

  • Play for over 40 minutes to unlock special content.

Please join our community and share your ideas and feedback.

A fusion of Brotato and the classic Pinball game from old Windows systems!

PengPong is a single-player survivor-like shooter starring a penguin armed with nothing but a hockey stick and the power to bounce everything in sight.

Set against the backdrop of 1940s–60s American amusement culture, PengPong delivers a pinball-inspired survival show filled with unpredictable ricochet action and vintage-style monsters straight out of old-school animation.

Don’t attack. Just bounce.

Combat in PengPong revolves not around direct attacks, but around using objects in the environment to strike back. While you can hit enemies directly, the damage is minimal and it’s far from the main strategy.

Instead, you'll need to bounce a variety of objects with your hockey stick to take down enemies. Hockey pucks, darts, molotovs, even your allies; if it moves, it can bounce.

Each object reacts differently. Bounce a molotov and you’ll set part of the map ablaze. Hit a teammate, and they’ll spin across the screen, striking down enemies on their own.

Choosing the right object at the right time is the key to survival.

Bounce. Collect. Survive.

Clear waves of quirky enemies, collect chips, and make it through alive. Between waves, you can spend your chips on fixed-price items at the shop or test your luck by feeding them into unpredictable machines. With a bit of luck, a rare and powerful item might just land in your flippers.

Sometimes, hidden rooms appear behind the shop. In these secret places, items demand a different kind of payment, not chips, but a piece of the penguin’s soul, the very cold that keeps you alive. The choice is yours.

If you manage to escape the map, you can exchange your chips for a large sum of cash. Before facing the next stage, use it to upgrade your hockey stick and prepare for a brand new run. No two sessions are the same, but the bounce always matters.

Developer’s Note

PengPong began with a simple idea: what if you couldn’t attack enemies directly but had to bounce things at them instead? Designed with intuitive controls and physics-based combat, the game is built to offer a fresh sense of strategy and progression with every run. Even a single angle of reflection can change the outcome, and every object you choose to bounce brings new tactical possibilities.

If PengPong reminds you of the art style of Cuphead, then congratulations! You’re definitely a true game enthusiast who knows their Steam titles well! That’s because PengPong also seeks to portray the era and amusement culture of 1940s - 1960s America, just like Cuphead, featuring old-school animation-style monsters and unpredictable ricochet action.

More maps, weapons, and monsters will be added to PengPong in the future, so stay tuned for its ever-expanding journey!

short_description: PengPong is a single-player survivor-like shooter where you play as a penguin with a hockey stick who bounces everything in sight. Inspired by 1940s–60s American amusement culture, it features chaotic pinball-style combat and vintage cartoon monsters in a unique survival showdown.
